节点、订阅、凭据、日志和规则库都保存在这个目录中。: Nodes, subscriptions, credentials, logs and rule data are stored in this directory.
选择新目录后应用会自动重启，把现有文件复制到新目录；原目录保留，目标目录中的同名: After you choose a new directory, vRay restarts automatically and copies existing files there. The old directory is kept, and files with the same name in the target are not overwritten. When restoring the default directory, vRay first backs up the old default-directory data beside it.
数据目录已设置，正在重启并迁移文件…: Data directory set. Restarting and migrating files…
数据目录设置已保存，将在下次启动时迁移。: The data-directory setting is saved and will be migrated on the next start.
每天 04:00 自动检查更新: Check for updates automatically every day at 04:00
自动检查只查询已签名的发布版本；发现新版本后仍由你确认安装。: Automatic checks only query signed releases. You still choose whether to install a new version.
该版本未提供发布说明。: This release does not include notes.
你正在使用最新版本。: You are running the latest version.
当前构建或安装位置不支持自动更新。可从 GitHub Releases 手动下载: This build or install location does not support automatic updates. Download the release from GitHub.
更新已下载并校验完成，重启应用后生效。: The update was downloaded and verified. Restart the app to apply it.
当前构建或安装位置不支持自动更新: This build or install location does not support automatic updates
更新操作超时，请稍后重试: The update timed out. Try again later.
vRay 将 Xray 内核嵌入本地应用，提供节点、订阅、规则和策略组管理。: vRay embeds the Xray core in a local app for managing nodes, subscriptions, routing rules and policy groups.
首次使用前请阅读并同意以下条款: Read and accept these terms before using vRay
同意后才能启动订阅更新、Geo 下载和应用更新检查。: Subscription refreshes, Geo downloads and update checks start only after you agree.
vRay 是本地 Xray 客户端，不提供代理服务器、节点或订阅内容。你需要自行: vRay is a local Xray client. It does not provide proxy servers, nodes or subscription content. You must verify that node sources, configurations and network services are lawful and trustworthy.
使用 vRay 时必须遵守所在国家或地区的法律法规、网络服务商条款及目标服务的使: You must comply with applicable laws, internet provider terms and the rules of services you access. Do not use vRay for unlawful activity, infringement, attacks, fraud or disruption of networks.
代理、TUN、系统代理和订阅更新会改变网络路径或系统设置。请了解相关风险，并在操: Proxy, TUN, system proxy and subscription refreshes can change network paths or system settings. Understand the risks and back up important data. vRay stores node and subscription configuration, exit information and speed-test results in its local data directory.
更新功能会访问 GitHub 发布页，只安装与内置公钥签名匹配的版本。自动检查可: The update feature accesses GitHub releases and installs only versions signed for vRay's built-in public key. You can disable automatic checks and decide whether to install any new version.
软件按现状提供，不承诺持续可用、无错误或适合特定用途。在法律允许的范围内，作者不: The software is provided as is, without a promise of continuous availability, freedom from errors or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law, the authors are not liable for losses caused by misconfiguration, node failure, network interruption, data loss, third-party services or misuse.
继续使用表示你已阅读并同意本免责声明与使用协议。: By continuing, you confirm that you have read and accept this Disclaimer and Terms of Use.
最近 30 秒的实测峰值: Measured peak in the last 30 seconds
最近 30 秒，每秒更新: Last 30 seconds, updated once per second
TUN 需要管理员权限，请以管理员身份运行 vRay 后重试: TUN requires administrator privileges. Run vRay as administrator and try again.
请先退出 vRay，在程序或快捷方式上点击右键，选择以管理员身份运行，然后重新连: Exit vRay, right-click the application or its shortcut, choose Run as administrator, then reconnect.
请将便携包中的 wintun.dll 放在程序旁边，确认驱动架构与程序一致，然后: Place the portable package's wintun.dll beside the executable, check that its architecture matches, then reconnect.
系统代理模式无需管理员权限，可直接切换使用。: System proxy mode works without administrator privileges.
粘贴分享链接或订阅地址，自动识别内容格式。: Paste share links or a subscription URL. The format is detected automatically.
留空时自动命名，仅用于订阅来源: Optional name for the subscription source
支持订阅链接、分享链接、Clash 与 Base64: Supports subscription URLs, share links, Clash and Base64
将保存订阅来源，后续可更新和编辑: Saved as a source that you can refresh and edit later
正在获取订阅并导入节点…: Fetching the subscription and importing nodes…
仅保存选择，不影响当前连接: Saves this choice without affecting the current connection
此分组参与当前出站，切换成员会重新连接: This group participates in the active outbound. Changing its member reconnects.
本组没有可检测的 TCP 节点: This group has no TCP nodes to check
组内 TCP 节点超过 256 个，请先缩小分组: This group has more than 256 TCP nodes. Narrow the group before checking.
选择自动保存；仅更改当前出站时重新连接: Choices are saved automatically. Only changes to the active outbound reconnect.
直连模式已开启，策略组将在规则或全局模式下使用: Direct routing is enabled. Policies apply in Rule or Global mode.
点击成员即可选择并保存；组内箭头可进入下级分组。: Click a member to save your choice. Use its arrow to open a nested group.
按 HTTP 健康检测的延迟自动选择节点，无需手动切换。: Automatically chooses a node using HTTP health-check latency.
优先使用靠前的健康节点；延迟排序仅改变显示顺序。: Uses healthy nodes in subscription order. Sorting changes the display only.
新连接按成员轮询分配，适合同时使用多条线路。: Distributes new connections across members in rotation.
修改当前出站会重新连接；未连接时只保存选择: Changing the active outbound reconnects. While disconnected, choices are saved for the next connection.
没有匹配的成员，请调整搜索或筛选。: No matching members. Adjust the search or filter.
选择会自动保存，连接后生效: Choices are saved and applied on connection
HTTP 为代理健康检测，TCP 为端口建连延迟: HTTP: proxy health check. TCP: endpoint connection latency.
按延迟排序；再次点击恢复订阅顺序: Sort by latency; click again to restore subscription order
检测本组及下级分组的 TCP 节点，不切换出站: Check TCP nodes in this group and nested groups without switching the outbound
查看订阅策略组，选择默认出站或组内节点。: View subscription policies and choose a default outbound or group member.
导入或更新包含 proxy-groups 的 Clash 订阅后，策略组会出现在: Import or refresh a Clash subscription with proxy-groups to see its policies here.
可新建自定义策略组，或导入包含 proxy-groups 的 Clash 订阅。: Create a custom policy group or import a Clash subscription with proxy-groups.
连接中更改策略会重新连接: Changing policies while connected restarts the connection
自动测速选择低延迟节点；故障转移按顺序选择；负载均衡按连接轮询。: Latency policies choose a low-latency node; failover follows member order; load balancing rotates connections.
最近 60 秒的实测峰值: Measured peak in the last 60 seconds
按用户规则和 Geo 规则分流，未匹配的流量使用当前节点: Apply custom and Geo rules; route unmatched traffic through the current node
除本地网络外，全部流量使用当前节点: Use the current node for all traffic except the local network
流量直接连接目标；保留代理入口和当前节点配置: Connect to destinations directly while retaining the local proxy and node configuration
；连接中切换将重新连接: ; changing this while connected restarts the connection
通过虚拟网卡接管流量: Route traffic through the virtual adapter
复制本地 HTTP / SOCKS 代理地址: Copy the local HTTP / SOCKS proxy address
当前节点为手动导入: The current node was imported manually
在订阅页添加订阅或选择节点: Add a subscription or select a node on the subscriptions page
检测当前节点的 TCP 建连延迟: Measure the current node's TCP connection latency
当前节点的 TCP 建连耗时: TCP connection latency of the current node
执行 GC 并将空闲 Go 堆内存归还系统；仍在使用的内存会保留: Run GC and return idle Go heap pages to the OS; live memory remains in use
选择下一站，找到适合你的连接。: Find the right node for your connection.
查看正在经过 vRay 的 TCP 连接与 UDP 会话。: View TCP connections and UDP sessions passing through vRay.
让每一次连接，都走合适的路线。: Choose the right route for each connection.
查看运行记录，了解连接情况。: View runtime logs and connection events.
同时探测的节点数。数值越大，测速越快，但会占用更多网络连接。: Number of nodes tested at the same time. Higher values finish large lists faster but use more network connections.
单个节点建立 TCP 连接的最长等待时间。超时后标记为失败。: Maximum time to establish a TCP connection to one node. A timeout marks the node as failed.
并行数量必须是数字: Parallel test count must be a number
并行数量需在 1–64 之间: Parallel test count must be between 1 and 64
单节点超时必须是数字: Per-node timeout must be a number
单节点超时需在 1–60000 毫秒之间: Per-node timeout must be between 1 and 60000 milliseconds
测试当前选中节点的单连接下载速度，最多使用 32 MiB 下载流量: Test the selected node's single-connection download speed, using at most 32 MiB
搜索目标、来源、节点或协议: Search destination, source, node or protocol
打开网页或应用后，经过 vRay 的连接会自动出现在这里。: Connections appear here when traffic passes through vRay.
连接节点后，在这里查看实时网络连接。: Connect a node to view live network connections here.
调整搜索关键词或协议筛选。: Change the search query or protocol filter.
点击左侧连接，查看地址、出口与流量。: Select a connection to view its address, outbound and traffic.
仅显示活动连接，结束后自动移除。: Only active connections are shown; closed sessions disappear automatically.
部分 VLESS Vision 直通连接会批量更新流量，数值可能暂时滞后。: Some VLESS Vision direct-copy connections update counters in batches; values may lag.
选择节点，查看连接与 IP 信息: Select a node to view connection and IP details
首次查询后保存在本地，之后仅在手动更新时重新查询。: Saved locally after the first lookup; refreshed only on request.
已保留上次成功查询的记录: The last successful lookup is retained
已保留上次成功测速结果: The last successful speed test is retained
单连接测量，下载阶段最长 8 秒 / 最多 32 MiB；结果保存在本地，仅手动: Single-connection test, up to 8 seconds or 32 MiB. Results are saved locally and refreshed only on request.
添加一个订阅来源，在这里查看节点、更新状态与剩余配额。: Add a subscription to view nodes, refresh status and remaining quota.
粘贴分享链接或订阅地址（https://…），也支持多条链接与 base64 订: Paste share links or a subscription URL (https://…); multiple links and base64 subscriptions are supported.
https://… 订阅地址，或 vless://… / vmess://… /: https://… subscription URL, or vless://… / vmess://… / trojan://… / hysteria2://…
0 为仅手动更新；自动更新最小 15 分钟: 0 means manual refresh only; the minimum automatic interval is 15 minutes
留空使用 vRay 默认值: Leave blank to use the vRay default
移除此订阅来源？默认保留节点，并归入手动导入。: Remove this subscription? Nodes are retained as manual imports by default.
geosite 用于域名分组，geoip 用于 IP 地区。选择模板后可编辑匹配: geosite groups domains; geoip groups IP regions. Choose a template, then edit its matches and outbound.
规则库未就绪：下载完成后重新连接，Geo 规则才会生效。: Geo data is not ready. Reconnect after the download to apply Geo rules.
规则库未就绪时，含 Geo 条件的整条规则暂不启用；普通规则仍可使用。: Rules with Geo conditions stay disabled until Geo data is ready; ordinary rules remain available.
内置路由：局域网直连；规则库就绪后，国内域名直连。其余流量走当前节点。: Built-in routes: direct LAN access and domestic domains when Geo data is ready; other traffic uses the current node.
修改规则后重新连接生效；从上到下匹配，自定义规则优先于内置国内域名直连。: Reconnect to apply changes. Rules match from top to bottom; custom rules precede the domestic-domain default.
尚无自定义规则，仍按上方内置路由分流。可以从 Geo 模板开始，或新建自己的规则: No custom rules yet. Built-in routes still apply. Start with a Geo template or add a rule.
共 %d 条，从上到下依次匹配: %d rules, matched from top to bottom
同一字段内任意一项匹配；不同字段需同时满足。: Values within one field are ORed; different fields must all match.
可选：配置 ipapi.is 密钥以获取完整的网络类型和信誉评分。: Optional: configure an ipapi.is key for full network-type and reputation information.
统一控制内核日志采集，保存后立即生效；日志页只能进一步筛选。调试会记录更多连接细: Controls core log collection immediately after saving; the log page can only narrow it further. Debug records more connection details.
还没有日志。连接后内核的日志会出现在这里。: No logs yet. Core logs appear after connecting.
有 %d 行因写入繁忙未进入界面，文件里通常仍完整: %d lines were omitted from the UI while busy; the log file may still contain them
上次没有正常退出，已还原 %d 处系统设置: Restored %d system settings after an unclean shutdown
“%s”及其嵌套引用将被移除。正在使用的连接会在需要时重新连接。: “%s” and its nested references will be removed. Active connections will reconnect when needed.
策略组名称不能为空: The policy group name is required
策略组名称不能超过 80 个字符: The policy group name cannot exceed 80 characters
自动策略组至少需要两个成员: An automatic policy group needs at least two members
策略组至少需要一个成员: A policy group needs at least one member
策略组成员过多，最多支持 256 个: A policy group can contain at most 256 members
探测间隔需在 30–86400 秒之间: The probe interval must be between 30 and 86,400 seconds
请选择有效的策略组类型: Choose a valid policy group type
已有同名策略组: A policy group with this name already exists
策略组包含已移除或无效的成员: The policy group contains a removed or invalid member
探测地址必须是有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS 地址: The probe URL must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
订阅策略组由订阅更新维护，不能直接编辑: Subscription policy groups are maintained by subscription refreshes and cannot be edited directly
订阅策略组由订阅更新维护，不能直接删除: Subscription policy groups are maintained by subscription refreshes and cannot be deleted directly
保存策略组失败: Could not save the policy group
删除策略组失败: Could not delete the policy group
另一个策略操作正在进行，请稍后重试: Another policy operation is in progress. Try again shortly.
删除后策略组存在循环引用: Deleting this group would leave a circular policy reference
出口来自节点页最近一次持久化查询: Exits come from the most recent saved lookup on the Nodes page
批量操作仅作用于当前筛选结果: Bulk actions apply only to the current results
填写名称并选择成员后即可保存: Enter a name and select members to save
名称、协议、订阅、出口 IP 或地区: Name, protocol, subscription, exit IP or region
没有匹配的节点或分组。请调整搜索或先查询节点出口信息。: No matching nodes or groups. Adjust the search or query node exit information first.
选择顺序用于故障转移和负载均衡；可在每行上移或下移: Selection order affects failover and load balancing; move rows up or down to reorder
修改名称、类型、成员顺序或按出口信息重新组合节点: Change the name, type, member order, or rebuild the group from exit information
选择节点或已有分组，创建自动选择、故障转移或负载均衡策略: Choose nodes or existing groups to create latency, failover or load-balancing policies
点击下载、校验并准备更新；完成后可重启应用: Click to download, verify and stage the update; restart the app when it finishes
